Remark
[a synthetic characterization of exponential coordinates]

Source: petersen:page-0242 ↗ rem:pet-ch5-radial-isometry 1. ch5:5.9.30If coordinates $x^i$ near $p$ satisfy $x^i(p)=0$ and $g_{ij}x^j=\delta _{ij}x^j$, show they must be exponential normal coordinates. Hint: set $r=\sqrt{\delta _{ij}x^ix^j}$, show it is a smooth distance function away from $p$, and that the gradient's integral curves are geodesics emanating from $p$.
